paragraphs: Mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 2:3: R' Berekhiah—or, some say, R' Nechemiah ben Elazar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Supplied heading Eliezer differs from body Elazar and earlier machine/catalog Elazar. No harmonization or fresh printed proof is claimed.

איכ״ר פ״ב-ג is read as Eichah Rabbah chapter 2 section 3, not a 2–3 chapter range. No named edition is independently checked. Some-say retains the alternative Berekhiah/Nechemiah attribution; all three title abbreviations remain R'.
